title: Figure 2: Dipole gravitational field generator - pipe-wound torus (Forward antigravity)
description: Shaded line drawing of a torus wound with a helical pipe carrying mass flow "T," with arrows labeled "P" circulating inside the torus, looping field lines labeled "G" outside, and an upward "G" arrow at the center. The caption reads "Figure 2. Diople Gravitational Field Generator (Reference 14)." Text discusses the vacuum gravitational permeability constant and the need for dwarf-star-density matter to produce a 1-g antigravity field.
